en.title: Bounding Box from Coordinates
en.description:
Find the smallest axis-aligned rectangle that covers all 2D points, and output its bottom-left corner coordinates, width, and height.

The standard input/output format and any supplementary ranges on this site are as stated in this problem.
en.input: n (1≤n≤200000), followed by n lines of integers x y (−10^9≤x,y≤10^9).
en.output: Output minX minY width height, separated by spaces.
en.explanation: Maintain the minimum and maximum of x and y in a single pass.
hints: Maintain the minimum and maximum of x and y in a single pass.
